metadata.name: Splunk Enterprise Security Correlation Rules
metadata.description: Splunk ES correlation search rules for network-based C2 detection and exfiltration monitoring
metadata.author: DXC SOC Team

correlation_searches.name: Detect C2 Beaconing via Periodic Network Connections
correlation_searches.description: Identifies hosts making periodic outbound connections to external IPs with consistent time intervals, indicative of C2 beaconing behavior.
correlation_searches.search: index=network sourcetype=firewall_traffic action=allowed dest_port!=80 dest_port!=443 | bucket span=5m _time | stats count, dc(dest_ip) as unique_dest by src_ip, _time | eventstats avg(count) as avg_count, stdev(count) as stdev_count by src_ip | where abs(count - avg_count) < (stdev_count * 0.5) AND count > 10 | stats count as beacon_windows by src_ip | where beacon_windows > 12

notable.title: Potential C2 Beaconing Detected from $src_ip$
notable.description: Host $src_ip$ exhibits periodic connection patterns consistent with C2 beaconing.
notable.recommended_actions: Investigate outbound connections from affected host, check for malware infection, isolate if confirmed.

correlation_searches.name: Detect Large Data Transfer to External Destinations
correlation_searches.description: Detects unusually large outbound data transfers that may indicate data exfiltration by an insider or external attacker.
correlation_searches.search: index=network sourcetype=firewall_traffic action=allowed direction=outbound | stats sum(bytes_out) as total_bytes by src_ip, dest_ip | where total_bytes > 104857600 | eval total_mb = round(total_bytes/1048576, 2) | where NOT match(dest_ip, "^10\.") AND NOT match(dest_ip, "^172\.1[6-9]\.") AND NOT match(dest_ip, "^192\.168\.")

notable.title: Large Data Exfiltration Detected: $total_mb$ MB from $src_ip$ to $dest_ip$
notable.description: Unusual large data transfer detected to external destination.
notable.recommended_actions: Immediately investigate the source host, identify the process responsible, block destination IP if malicious.

correlation_searches.name: Brute Force Login Attempts Against Multiple Accounts
correlation_searches.description: Detects brute force password attacks targeting multiple accounts from a single source, indicating credential stuffing or password spraying.
correlation_searches.search: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 | stats count as failures, dc(user) as unique_users, values(user) as targeted_users by src_ip | where failures > 100 AND unique_users > 5 | eval attack_type = if(unique_users > 10, "Password Spray", "Brute Force")

notable.title: $attack_type$ Detected from $src_ip$ targeting $unique_users$ accounts
notable.description: Multiple failed login attempts detected against $unique_users$ unique user accounts.
notable.recommended_actions: Block source IP, check for successful logins from same IP, reset compromised account passwords.

correlation_searches.name: Detect Tor Exit Node Communication
correlation_searches.description: Identifies connections to known Tor exit nodes, which may indicate anonymized C2 communication or data exfiltration.
correlation_searches.search: index=network sourcetype=firewall_traffic action=allowed [| inputlookup tor_exit_nodes.csv | fields ip | rename ip as dest_ip] | stats count, values(src_ip) as internal_hosts, values(dest_ip) as tor_ips by _time | where count > 0

notable.title: Tor Exit Node Communication Detected from $internal_hosts$
notable.description: Internal host communicating with Tor exit node, possible anonymized C2 or exfiltration.
notable.recommended_actions: Isolate the affected host, investigate process making connections, check for malware.

correlation_searches.name: Detect Kerberoasting Attack
correlation_searches.description: Detects Kerberoasting attacks by monitoring for an unusually high number of Kerberos TGS requests for service accounts.
correlation_searches.search: index=wineventlog EventCode=4769 TicketOptions=0x40810000 TicketEncryptionType=0x17 | stats count, dc(ServiceName) as unique_services, values(ServiceName) as targeted_services by src_ip, user | where count > 5 AND unique_services > 3

notable.title: Kerberoasting Attack Detected from $src_ip$ by $user$
notable.description: Suspicious Kerberos TGS requests for $unique_services$ service accounts detected.
notable.recommended_actions: Investigate user account, reset service account passwords, check for privilege escalation.
